5 تهوّر : see هَارَ, in two places; in the former of which, تهيّر is also mentioned as syn. with تَهوّر. ―
-b2- (tropical:) He plunged, or fell, into an affair with little care [for the consequence thereof]: (S, K:) or تهوّر فِى الأُمُورِ he plunged, or fell, into affairs without thought, or reflection, or consideration: (A:) or تَهَوُّرٌ is a state, or condition, adventitious to the irascible faculty, by reason of which one ventures upon affairs not fit, or meet, to be ventured upon; as the fighting with unbelievers
when they are more than double the number of the Muslims. (KT.) ＝
-A2- تهوّرهُ: see هَارَهُ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
